summary: Nền tảng theo dõi lỗi và hiệu suất cho nhà phát triển, hỗ trợ nhiều ngôn ngữ với insights thời gian thực.
usecases: Track and monitor application crashes in production.
Performance profiling and APM for backend services.
Real-time error alerts and deployment tracking for DevOps teams.
ideas: Integrate with CI/CD pipelines to block merges on critical errors.
Combine with LLM analysis to auto-categorize and suggest fixes for recurring errors.
Use error data to automatically generate feature prioritization reports.
